# Rufus Vane

deceased

## Overview

- **Role:** sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LORNA RETURNS P9](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027)</sub>
- **Family:** [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) (cousin), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Rufus Vane is a large, good-looking, and severely overweight man with a wide, circular, florid face. His expressionless eyes are heterochromatic, with one being blue and the other hazel.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)_

## Personality

Rufus Vane is a large, good-looking man described as possessing a small, wicked soul. Though usually pleasant, simple to manage, and considered by some to be merely an oversized infant lacking in intellect, he can occasionally be vexing and is known to be a heavy drinker.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P31](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)_

## History

Rufus Vane inherited a nautical inclination from his mother and divided his time between sailing in the summer and clerking at his father Abner's store in the winter, residing with his wife [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) during the winter on the Ainslie place. While in Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever and passed away thirteen years ago, forcing his vessel, the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), to leave without him. For twelve years following his death, his cousin [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md) masqueraded in his place before the truth of Rufus's passing was ultimately revealed.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/laurence--rufus-vane.md)

[Laurence](../character/laurence.md) is Rufus's cousin who assumed his identity. The real Rufus died in Cuba long ago, allowing [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) to masquerade as him for twelve years before the truth was revealed.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), +1 more_

### [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lorna-vane--rufus-vane.md)

[Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) is Rufus's wife, though the man who lived as her husband for twelve years was actually his cousin [Laurence](../character/laurence.md). The real Rufus passed away in Cuba long before [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) traveled to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery and uncovered the deception.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), +11 more_
